Name: Poki's Bouquets
Author: EnbyFelix
Description:
Changes the vanilla bouquet to match my upcoming rose bouquets that will be sold by my shopkeeper, Poki.
There are 24 options, changeable by a config, now changeable per season! Options are:
[list]
[*]aqua
[*]black
[*]bleen (blue-green)
[*]blue
[*]blurple (blue-purple)
[*]brown
[*]gray
[*]green
[*]grello (green-yellow)
[*]lilac
[*]mint
[*]orange
[*]pearl
[*]pink
[*]purple
[*]radioactive
[*]red
[*]seafoam
[*]solar (essence)
[*]stardrop
[*]void (essence)
[*]white
[*]yellow
[*]yorange (yellow-orange)
[/list]
Only changes the sprite, nothing else.
More options are coming in the future.

Downloads.Description: Changes the vanilla bouquet to match Poki's bouquets, now seasonal!
